review_note: Drafted by one Claude session and reviewed by a different Claude session (8 of 40 tasks changed, none dropped; see docs/BENCHMARK.md). All tasks are TEST tasks; no retrieval tool was run to write or review them, so nothing is tuned. The repository owner has not reviewed this set.

tasks.query: middleware that checks the Basic Authorization header against a configured username and password and answers 401 with a realm
tasks.note: basicAuth builds the middleware that compares decoded Basic credentials (or a verifyUser callback) and returns 401 with a WWW-Authenticate realm otherwise.

tasks.query: map a request filename to a file path, appending index.html when it ends with a slash or has no extension
tasks.note: getFilePath appends the default document for directory-like names and then resolves the path under the root.

tasks.query: parse an Accept header string into a list of media types with parameters sorted by quality value
tasks.note: parseAccept splits the header, parses each value and sorts by q and index.

tasks.query: compare two strings safely against timing attacks by hashing both before comparing them
tasks.note: timingSafeEqual hashes both inputs (sha256 by default) and compares the digests plus the originals.

tasks.query: CORS middleware that sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin, allowed methods and headers and answers preflight OPTIONS requests
tasks.note: cors resolves the allowed origin/methods/headers and returns a 204 response for preflight requests.

tasks.query: forward a request to another origin with fetch and strip hop-by-hop headers from the response
tasks.note: proxy builds a Request, fetches it and deletes hop-by-hop and content-encoding headers from the response.

tasks.query: look up the MIME type for a filename extension and add charset utf-8 for text types
tasks.note: getMimeType matches the extension, looks it up in the mime table and appends the utf-8 charset for text/* types.

tasks.query: escape ampersand, angle brackets and quotes in a string and append the result to a string buffer
tasks.note: escapeToBuffer replaces &, <, >, " and ' with entities and appends the result to buffer[0].

tasks.query: return the Response of an HTTP exception, built from its message and status when no custom response was supplied
tasks.note: getResponse returns a copy of the custom res with the status, or a new Response from the message.

tasks.query: generate static HTML files from the routes of an app and write them to the file system with before and after hooks
tasks.note: toSSG requests every static route of the app, applies hooks and saves the content via the provided fs module.

tasks.query: runs an ordered list of handlers where each can call the following one, throws if that continuation is invoked twice, and routes failures to an error callback
tasks.note: compose returns a function whose dispatch(i) runs middleware[i] with a next that calls dispatch(i+1), guarding against repeated next() and using onError/onNotFound.

tasks.query: figure out which JavaScript platform the code is executing on, such as workerd, deno, bun, node, fastly or edge-light
tasks.note: getRuntimeKey checks navigator.userAgent, EdgeRuntime, fastly and process.release to return the platform name.

tasks.query: sets browser hardening fields on responses such as CSP, HSTS, frame options and permissions policy, with an optional per-request nonce
tasks.note: secureHeaders assembles the default and custom security header list (CSP, Permissions-Policy, reporting) and sets them on the response after next().

tasks.query: reject uploads bigger than a configured byte count with status 413, counting streamed chunks when no length is declared
tasks.note: bodyLimit trusts content-length when present, otherwise wraps the stream to count bytes, and calls onError (413) over maxSize.

tasks.query: given a route pattern whose last named segment ends with a question mark, return the paths with and without that segment
tasks.note: checkOptionalParameter expands /api/animals/:type? into [/api/animals, /api/animals/:type] and returns null otherwise.

tasks.query: wrap a function component so its previous output is reused unless a comparison of old and new props says they differ
tasks.note: memo caches the computed element and recomputes only when propsAreEqual (default shallowEqual) returns false.

tasks.query: walk the segment tree for a request path and collect matching handler sets with captured params, handling wildcards and regex segments
tasks.note: Node.search iterates over path parts through children and patterns, pushing handler sets with params for wildcard and named matches.

tasks.query: attach a foreign fetch-style application under a path prefix, stripping the prefix from the URL and forwarding env and execution context
tasks.note: Hono.mount rewrites the request URL by the prefix length, calls the external handler with env and executionCtx, and registers it for all methods on path/*.

tasks.query: limit how many async tasks run at the same time, queueing extra ones until slots free up, optionally holding a slot for an interval
tasks.note: createPool returns run(fn) that defers via setTimeout while the pool size is at concurrency and releases markers (optionally after interval).

tasks.query: prints one line when a request arrives and another when the response is ready, showing method, path, status and elapsed time
tasks.note: logger wraps next(), printing an incoming line and an outgoing line with status and elapsed time through the print function.

tasks.query: add a Set-Cookie header whose value carries an HMAC signature, supporting the secure and host name prefixes
tasks.note: setSignedCookie appends the header built by generateSignedCookie (prefix handling), which calls serializeSigned that signs the value with makeSignature.

tasks.query: protect routes by reading a token from the Authorization header or a cookie, checking its signature against a shared secret plus expiry and not-before claims, and storing the payload on the context
tasks.note: the jwt middleware (shared-secret variant; the jwk middleware uses key sets and is excluded by the query) extracts the token and calls verify, which checks claims and then the signature through jws verifying.

tasks.query: serve static files from a Workers KV asset namespace, using the asset manifest to find the storage key of each path
tasks.note: the adapter serveStatic supplies getContent that looks up the KV asset through getContentFromKVAsset (manifest -> storage key).

tasks.query: stream server-sent events to the client, formatting event, data, id and retry lines and writing them to an encoded stream
tasks.note: streamSSE sets the event-stream headers and runs the callback; writeSSE formats the message and StreamingApi.write encodes and writes it.

tasks.query: typed RPC client that turns chained property access into fetch calls, filling path params, query string and JSON or form body
tasks.note: hc creates the proxy, ClientRequestImpl builds and sends the request, and utils build the query string and substitute path params.

tasks.query: validate request input from json, form, query, header or cookie targets and keep the validated result available to later handlers
tasks.note: validator reads the target value, runs the user function and stores the result with addValidatedData; HonoRequest.valid returns it to later handlers.

tasks.query: add an ETag to responses by hashing the body stream and reply with 304 when If-None-Match matches
tasks.note: etag calls generateDigest on the cloned body stream (hash via the configured generator, SHA-1 default) and answers 304 when If-None-Match matches.

tasks.query: print the routes registered in an app to the console, coloring the method unless NO_COLOR is set
tasks.note: showRoutes lists routes from inspectRoutes and decides on coloring via getColorEnabled.

tasks.query: allow or deny clients by IPv4 or IPv6 address including CIDR ranges, converting addresses to binary numbers for comparison
tasks.note: ipRestriction applies deny and allow matchers from buildMatcher, which converts CIDR rules with the ipaddr binary conversion helpers.

tasks.query: provide a value to descendant JSX components, implemented for both server string rendering and browser DOM rendering
tasks.note: src/jsx/context.ts createContext builds the string-render provider and registers the DOM renderer made by createContextProviderFunction; src/jsx/dom/context.ts has its own createContext for the DOM renderer.
